app.name: Reliquary
app.tagline: Deck and collection manager for Magic: The Gathering

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: The shortcuts do not work while the focus is in a field.

actions.search: Go to the card search field
actions.newDeck: Make a deck, on the deck list
actions.addCard: Go to the field "Add a card", on the deck page

home.title: Manage your decks and your collection.
home.description: Reliquary is in early development. The first milestone creates the foundations: card data, card search and accounts.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist. Check the address.

update.available: A new version of Reliquary is available.

slots.contributionFailed: This part of the page has an error. The other parts continue to work.

errors.network_error: The application cannot reach the server. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.internal_error: The server has an error. Try again later.
errors.service_unavailable: The server is not available. Try again later.
errors.validation_failed: Some fields are not correct. Correct them, then try again.
errors.invalid_authentication: Your session stopped. Sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: You sent too many requests. Wait one minute, then try again.
errors.quota_exceeded: This API key used all its requests for today.
errors.session_expired: Your session stopped. Sign in again.
errors.api_key_limit: You have the maximum number of API keys. Revoke a key, then try again.
errors.delegation_limit: You have the maximum number of delegations. Revoke a delegation, then try again.
errors.provider_not_enabled: This sign-in service is not available on this instance.
errors.external_sign_in_failed: The sign-in with the external service failed. Try again.
errors.external_email_missing: The external service did not give an email address. Use a different sign-in method.
errors.external_email_not_verified: The external service did not check your email address. Check the address on that service, or sign in with your password.
errors.search_syntax_error: The search has a syntax error. Correct the search, then try again.
errors.search_query_empty: The search has no condition that the application knows. Change the search.
errors.search_timeout: The search took too much time. Make the search more specific.
errors.report_exists: You sent a report about this item before. An administrator reads it soon.
errors.report_closed: An administrator closed this report before. Read the list again.
errors.location_locked: The location is locked. Unlock the location, then try again.
errors.location_not_empty: The location or one of its sections has cards. Move or remove the cards, then try again.
errors.deck_location: This location is an assembled deck. Change the deck to change the location.
errors.not_enough_cards: The origin does not have enough copies of the card. Give a lower quantity.
errors.inventory_applied: Reliquary applied this inventory before. Start a new inventory.
errors.deck_assembled: The deck is an assembled deck. Release it first, then try again.
errors.deck_not_assembled: The deck is not an assembled deck. Mark a version as the assembled version first.
errors.deck_link_site_unavailable: This instance cannot read the decks of this site. On the site, export the deck as text and paste the text below.
errors.deck_link_not_found: The site has no public deck at this link. Make sure that the deck is public or unlisted.
errors.deck_link_site_failed: The other site did not give the deck. Try again later, or export the deck as text and paste the text.
errors.game_invite_invalid: The invite link is not valid. It expired, or the host made a new link. Ask the host for the current link.
errors.game_token_invalid: Your place in the game is not valid. Open the invite link again to join the game.
errors.game_full: The game has no free place. Ask the host to remove a player or to make a new game.
errors.game_started: The game started. A new player cannot join it.
errors.game_open_limit: You have 3 open games. Close a game, then create a new game.
errors.game_not_enough_players: The game needs 2 players or more. Send the invite link to another player.
errors.plugin_format_failed: The plugin did not convert the file. Check the file, or select a different format.
errors.consent_required: The plugin asks for access that you did not accept. Read the access, then accept it.
errors.consent_outdated: The plugin changed while the dialog was open. Close the dialog and read the access again.
errors.too_many_active_plugins: You have the maximum number of active plugins. Deactivate a plugin, then try again.
errors.vault_not_configured: The instance cannot keep an API key. Tell the administrator of the instance.
errors.vault_key_missing: The instance lost the key of this secret. Link the account again.
errors.vault_secret_unreadable: The instance cannot read this secret. Link the account again.
errors.linked_account_method_not_supported: This sign-in method is not available yet.
errors.catalog_not_configured: The instance has no plugin catalog. Set the address of a catalog index in the settings of the instance.
errors.catalog_sync_failed: The sync of the plugin catalog failed. Read the logs of the API, then try again.

fieldErrors.invalid_format: This value does not have the correct format.

plugins.notCheckedDescription: The plugin {{name}} comes from a development URL. Reliquary did not review it. Use it only to develop a plugin.
plugins.actionFailed: The plugin {{name}} did not complete the action.
plugins.panelFailed: The panel of the plugin {{name}} did not answer. Close the panel and open it again.
plugins.pageUnavailable: This plugin page is not available. Make sure that the plugin is active for your account.
plugins.cellFailed: The plugin {{name}} did not give this cell.
plugins.disabledByCore: Reliquary deactivated the plugin {{name}}, because it failed too many times. You can activate it again in the panel Plugins of your account.

adminPlugins.title: Plugins of the instance
adminPlugins.forbidden: Only the administrators can open this page.
adminPlugins.description: Install the plugins of the catalog and enable them for the instance. Then each user activates a plugin in the panel Plugins of their account and accepts its access.

catalog.title: Plugin catalog
catalog.notConfigured: The instance has no plugin catalog. Set Plugins:Catalog:Url to the address of a catalog index.
catalog.neverSynced: The instance did not get the catalog index yet.
catalog.state: Index {{serial}}. Last sync: {{checked}}. The index expires on {{expires}}.

adminPlugins.synced: The catalog has the index {{serial}}. New plugin versions: {{added}}. New revoked versions: {{revoked}}.
adminPlugins.empty: The instance has no plugin. Sync the catalog to get its plugins.

state.revoked: Version {{version}}. The catalog revoked this version: {{reason}}
state.notCompatible: Version {{version}}. This version does not support this version of Reliquary.

adminPlugins.enabled: The plugin {{name}} (version {{version}}) is enabled for the instance.
adminPlugins.disabled: The plugin {{name}} is not enabled for the instance.
adminPlugins.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall the plugin {{name}}? The plugin stops for all the users.
